diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker settled on harvest allocations and gardening schedules that did not depend on the hidden information. Specifically, the decisions about the harvest allocation (C1) were always set to 15 kg for the food pantry and 25 kg for the family, which is a common default or cautious choice. This allowed C1 to pass without accessing PF1, PF2, PF3, or PF4.
